{{Otheruses|New Dawn}}
'''''New Dawn''''' was a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] in the [[Druckenwell system/Legends|Druckenwell system]], that was near to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Druckenwell/Legends|Druckenwell]]. It was taken over by the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Renij Jaa]], who commanded [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] troops in the [[Star system/Legends|system]] was based on it.
